caption:
Mr Turtle is a dentist who spends all day leaning over the chair, and by home time his neck and upper back ache.

Dropping just your head can leave the neck holding its weight for long stretches. Hinging from the hips and changing position between patients can share the load.

Hybi's tip: chin tucks, shoulder blade squeezes and a quick chest opener between patients. Clinical Pilates can help build trunk and upper back support.

Arm or hand tingling or frequent headaches are worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physio-led clinical Pilates team can help. Book online via the link in bio
